modules.name: Plugin Core
modules.responsibility: Guice-injected plugin lifecycle (startUp/shutDown), the 45s poll loop, reminder-milestone logic, and the user-facing config schema - the orchestrator that wires the API client's results into the panel's state.

key_files.purpose: Plugin entrypoint: startUp/shutDown, poll loop scheduling (scheduleWithFixedDelay), join-button handler, reminder milestone dedupe (remindersShown set).
RuneLite ConfigGroup interface declaring token, apiBase, websiteBase, guildId settings with defaults.

modules.name: API Client
modules.responsibility: Wraps OkHttp calls to the catabot backend's plugin API (GET /events, POST /signup) behind an async callback interface, and classifies failures so callers can branch on cause (unauthorized vs. network vs. server).

key_files.purpose: fetchEvents() and signup() - builds requests, attaches Bearer auth header, parses JSON responses via Gson, routes errors through ApiCallback.
Generic async result interface (onSuccess/onError) used by all API calls.
Enum classifying failures: UNAUTHORIZED (401), NETWORK (request never reached server), SERVER (unexpected status/malformed body).

modules.name: API DTOs
modules.responsibility: Gson-deserialized request/response shapes mirroring the catabot backend's JSON contract exactly, including snake_case-to-camelCase field mapping via @SerializedName.

key_files.purpose: Core event model - id, title, start_at, status, discord_channel_id, nested Attendance; owns isSignedUp() and minutesUntilStart() (throws on unparsable start_at).
Wraps the events list returned by GET /events.
POST /signup request body (event_id).
POST /signup response body (event_id, status).

modules.name: UI / Panel
modules.responsibility: Swing presentation layer: the top-level state-routed side panel (not-linked / connection-error / events, All Events vs. My Events tabs), presentational event cards, the inline settings form, and a small custom-painted widget kit backing the gold-on-black theme.

key_files.purpose: Top-level PluginPanel: state machine (NOT_LINKED/CONNECTION_ERROR/EVENTS), tab routing, 30s local re-render ticker, settings toggle.
Expanded 'featured' card for the soonest joined event on the My Events tab (countdown, attendance, join/view-event buttons, disabled 'coming soon' feature rows).
Compact list row used on All Events and for secondary joined events on My Events.
Inline 'Event Setup' form (gear icon) - reads/writes token, apiBase, websiteBase, guildId straight to ConfigManager.
Centralized color/spacing/font constants for the custom-painted theme (no default Swing L&F).
Custom-painted pill/outlined button variants used throughout the panel.
Round icon button used for the footer's Discord and settings-gear actions.
Rounded-rect card container used as the base of EventHeroCard and EventCompactRow.
Small rounded badge, used for the 'STARTING SOON' indicator.
Multi-line wrapping JLabel replacement, used for event titles.
Generated avatar/initial icon shown next to event titles.
